_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run. One opportunity gained a genuine score movement: help-desk-tiered-support-flattens-agentic-automation moved from 3 to 4 after a Gartner survey of 321 customer-service/support leaders (55% stable staffing, 20% report AI-driven headcount reduction, 85% expanding human-agent responsibilities) was added as a second independent institution corroborating the single-case McKinsey 'redeployment not reduction' finding -- corroborationBreadth 1->3, two tiers now represented. Notably, this same Gartner survey wave is already recorded (since 2026-09-21) as CONTRADICTING evidence against the separate ai-bifurcates-it-staffing-support-contracts-infra-grows opportunity; the two readings are reconciled in both summaries via the existing relatedTo edge -- one is about net headcount trend, the other about the redeployment mechanism. No new opportunities founded: a promising Deloitte '2026 State of Product Survey' lead for the thin Product Management role (n=3,235) could not be verified past its gated landing page (Deloitte blocked to WebFetch in this sandbox) so nothing was admitted on unverified aggregator-site numbers; a promising Gartner QA-automation one-minute-insights piece (n=248) for the thin QA/Test Engineering role could not have its publish date confirmed, so it was left out per the hard recency filter rather than guessed. Both are flagged in the findings log for a more direct pull next run. Red-teamed all eleven evidenceScore>=4 opportunities (ten from last run plus the newly-qualifying help-desk one); no new threshold-clearing contradictions found for any -- several searches (governance maturity, data-foundation investment) surfaced material that reinforces rather than contradicts existing theses. Under-covered roles searched again (Product Management 1, QA/Test Engineering 2, Data Engineering 3, Help Desk/IT Support 3 -- unchanged, since this run's help-desk work was a score movement on an existing opportunity, not a new one). Census BTOS and MIT CISR (priority sources) searched; both confirmed already fully captured. BLS (consecutiveEmptyRuns 8) and NBER (10) remain above the dead-source threshold, both incremented again -- flagged as overdue for a differently-framed search next run (specific occupational codes / working-paper browsing rather than keyword search). Gartner yielded a new admitted finding this run and reset to 0.
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
